notes.title: Seraph – Game Content Update Announcement (June 27)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/57a6de632b5168882f98b3754fe0fc27d9ebc91a.png[/img]
Dear players,

Following the upcoming maintenance, Seraph will implement the following updates and optimizations to enhance gameplay:

[h2]🔐 1. “Void Realm Key” Mechanic Reinstated (Applicable to Higher-Level Void Realm Dungeons)[/h2]
To rebalance resource acquisition and emphasize challenge-based content, the Void Realm Key mechanic will be officially reinstated starting today for dungeon levels 15 and above:
[olist]
[*]From Level 15 onward, each dungeon run will require 3 Void Realm Keys, with each key granting an additional 8 Soul Spars (total bonus: +24 Soul Spars).
[*]Completing a dungeon without using keys will result in reduced Soul spars rewards. Please manage your resource usage accordingly.
[*]Players found to be using cheating software will have their Void Realm Keys frozen and rendered unusable.
[/olist]📅 Key System Reinstatement: Effective Immediately
🛒 Void Realm Keys are now available via designated in-game channels.

[h2]⚔️ 2. “Mystic Domain Treasure Hunt” (Guild GvG) Beta Test[/h2]
The brand-new Guild vs Guild mode, Mystic Domain Treasure Hunt, is now entering its testing phase:
[list]
[*] This week marks the registration period. All guilds are welcome to sign up and participate.
[*] The feature will operate as a trial version this season. Please refer to upcoming announcements and in-game prompts for full details on mechanics and rules.
[/list]

[h2]⚙️ 3. Mercenary Dungeon Lag Optimization[/h2]
We’ve implemented fixes to reduce lag and input delay within certain Mercenary Dungeon scenes, improving overall responsiveness and performance.

Thank you for your continued understanding and support. Stay tuned for more exciting updates!

Seraph Steam Operations Team

notes.title: Seraph Hotfix Update (No Downtime) – June 19, 2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/26de44cb9844dd469f030d4015f7760fa168dc72.png[/img]
Dear Players,

We have completed a new round of hotfix updates without server downtime today. This patch aims to enhance overall gameplay experience and resolve several functionality issues.

[h2]🔧 Update Highlights[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Pet Auto-Dismantle & Sell Function Optimization
Pet will now automatically identify and prioritize selling white-quality gear for gold when executing dismantle commands, helping players manage inventory more efficiently.
[*] Dungeon Gate Mechanism Adjustment[list]
[*] The duration of an open dungeon instance has been extended from 30 minutes to 1 hour.
[*] If no players enter the dungeon for 1 hour, the gate will automatically close.
[/list][*] Mercenary Dungeon Lag Issue Fixed
Resolved a problem causing lag or input delay when entering Mercenary Dungeons on certain devices, improving combat smoothness and stability.
[/olist]
[h2]⚠️ Important Reminder[/h2]
Please restart your game client to ensure the update is fully applied.
If you experience any issues after the update, don’t hesitate to contact us via official customer support channels — we’ll assist you as quickly as possible.

Thank you for your continued support and understanding.
Enjoy your time in-game!

Seraph Steam Operations Team

notes.title: SERAPH Steam Version – New Season FAQ
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/535b1e52d6e08f5cfcbbe13f65beb99b454da31a.png[/img]

[h3]1. How do I access the Steam version? How should I select a server?
[/h3]
Players can download the client via Steam. If you’ve played previous seasons, simply update the client through Steam.
There are four regional servers (Asia, Europe, North America, and South America). Choose the one with the best connection speed for optimal performance.

[h3]2. What is the schedule for this season?
[/h3]
The season begins on June 12 at 11:00 AM (UTC+8).
The end date will be announced via the official community channels.

[h3]3. Can I livestream, record, or share game content on social media?
[/h3]
Yes, as long as it complies with applicable laws, platform policies, and community standards.
However, unauthorized datamining, theft of assets, or defamatory actions are strictly prohibited, and legal action may be taken.

[h3]4. How can I obtain Soul Spears?
[/h3]
After reaching level 60 and equipping a Chaos Treasure, you can earn Soul Spears by completing Void Otherworld challenges.

[h3]5. What if an NPC or quest monster disappears and I can’t complete a quest?
[/h3]
Click your character avatar and leave the instance, then re-enter the map. This will refresh the NPCs and quest objectives.
(Note: Even solo gameplay uses instanced rooms.)

[h3]6. What if I can’t summon my pet?
[/h3]
Pets have time-limited usage. Please check the Pet menu for expiration details.

[h3]7. How do I claim new and returning player rewards?
[/h3]
All accounts, including new ones, will automatically receive:
Season Pass
Stall Permit (Season)
Ascension Item (Total value: $135 USD)

These are delivered directly to your character’s inventory.
Note: The Season Pass is not usable in the Steam version.
The Ascension Item for new users is a Standard Ascension Item.

Returning players can click “Welfare” > “Veteran Rewards” in the menu to manually claim their bonuses.
> Includes a Season Pass usable in Steam and a Premium Ascension Item.
> Each account may only claim this once, so choose the character wisely.

[h3]8. How do I use the reward items I received?
[/h3]
Season Pass: Unlock via the Season Pass interface.
Stall Permit: Activate through the stall setup menu.
Ascension Item: Right-click in your inventory to use.

⚠️ Only one Ascension Item (Standard or Premium) may be used per account. Once used, the other becomes unusable. Choose carefully.

[h3]9. Why is my previous season character missing?
[/h3]
The game uses a seasonal system. At the end of each season, all data is wiped.
For details, refer to earlier announcements.
Content eligible for inheritance can be found under “Welfare” > “Season Inheritance”.
> Please note: Inheritance must be claimed all at once, not partially, and must be claimed on the correct character.

[h3]10. How can I contact the official team during gameplay?
[/h3]
Players can submit feedback, suggestions, or bug reports (especially critical issues) via the Steam platform (email or forums). Significant contributions may receive special rewards.

notes.title: SERAPH Steam Version New Season Preview: The NPC AI Agent System!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

After months of dedicated development, the SERAPH team is proud to unveil a revolutionary feature arriving in the new season: the AI Agent System! Centered on the theme of “Deep Interaction and Emotional Connection,” this system empowers the game’s ecosystem through advanced AI technology—infusing the world of SERAPH with living, breathing personality.

[h2]1. Agent Unlocking: A Journey of Mutual Bonding[/h2]
All AI agent NPCs will be integrated into the new “Social – NPC Friends” interface. Unlocking them will grant access to exclusive interaction-driven storylines. Two immersive paths are available for unlocking:
[list]
[*] Story Resonance: Progress through key main/side quests to gradually reveal each agent’s backstory. (Players with Direct Upgrade privileges may unlock all story-linked agents instantly.)
[*] Challenge Certification: Complete trials specific to each agent—such as tactical simulations or puzzle challenges—to earn their recognition.
[*] Design Philosophy: Each agent is a unique narrative node; unlocking them marks the beginning of a personal epic in character development.
[/list]
[h2]2. Dialogue Challenges: The Art of Dynamic Semantic Interaction[/h2]
Once unlocked, agents can engage in Dialogue Challenges—these aren’t simple scripted conversations, but real-time semantic interactions based on dynamic language understanding.
[list]
[*] Intelligent Response System: Conversations will trigger key phrases or hidden emotional conditions (e.g., empathetic support, strategic persuasion) to progress. The AI parses and reacts to contextual depth in real time.
[*] Seasonal Reward Loops:
[list]
[*] First-time completion yields exclusive resources (challenges reset each season);
[*] Weekly Agent Care Plan: The system will randomly select NPCs you've completed to send personalized messages with season points or rare items—offering a meaningful “remembered by the NPC” experience.
[*] Optimized Interaction Frequency: Daily conversation limits ensure server stability and encourage consistent player engagement.
[/list][/list]
[h2]3. Technological Leap: A New Era of NPC Interaction[/h2]
This system combines emotional computing models with enhanced behavior decision trees to deliver:
[list]
[*] Personality Expression: Each agent has an individual personality matrix (e.g., aloof, calm, sly), and their dialogue strategies evolve based on your relationship.
[*] Contextual Memory: The AI retains cross-session preferences to generate evolving, persistent narrative branches.
[*] Low-Latency Interaction: Our proprietary inference engine ensures millisecond-level response time for a seamless, immersive experience.
[/list]

The new season will launch globally soon!
Our team is continuously enhancing the agent behavior library and narrative network. Upcoming features include AI Agents as Combat Companions and Cross-NPC Dynamic Events—stay tuned!

The SERAPH Steam Operations Team

notes.title: SERAPH Early Access Test Version Overview
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

The Early Access Test for SERAPH is officially live! 
We are thrilled to introduce the exciting content available in this version.  

1. Game Content

🌍 World & Storyline
- Explore a dark medieval fantasy world filled with hidden secrets.  
- The main storyline spans 10 chapters, leading players through an epic journey of discovery.  
- Each chapter contains multiple themed regions with unique landscapes and challenges.  

⚔️ Classes & Combat
- Choose from five distinct classes: Barbarian, Sorceress, Valkyrie, Necromancer, and Druid, each with unique skills and progression paths.  
- The level cap is 99, allowing for deep character development.  

🕳️ Dungeon Systems
- After completing the main storyline, three core endgame modes will be unlocked:  
  - Void Abyss: Features T1 to T18 randomly generated maps with increasing difficulty.  
  - Chaos Rift: A high-risk, high-reward dungeon system.  
  - Trial of Heaven: A challenging mode for elite adventurers.  
- These modes can be played solo or in a team.  

💰 Economy & Progression
- Enjoy a comprehensive character growth system, including leveling, gear upgrades, and skill enhancements.  
- The market is open, allowing free trade of in-game items between players.  

2. Marketplace & Item Shop

- The in-game shop is now open, offering a variety of items and bundles.  
- Players can purchase daily-limited packs using in-game currency.  
- Exclusive premium packs are also available for purchase with real currency.  

3. Additional Information

- This is a non-wipe, unlimited access test, meaning all progress will be retained.  
- If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please reach out via Steam forums or our official community channels.  

We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy your journey in SERAPH!  

SERAPH Steam Operations Team

notes.title: ‘SERAPH: In the Darkness’ Steam page opens… Mobile version will also be released
notes.notes:
The 3D ARPG "SERAPH: In the Darkness," developed by Seraph Studio and published by CHERRY CREDITS, has opened its Steam page. The game is scheduled for a mobile version release in the future.

The game's story is set in a world where humans, angels, and demons coexist. In the beginning, angels and humans collaborated to seal demons in hell. However, after a long period of prosperity and complacency, human greed became uncontrollable. Conflicts and wars erupted throughout the human world, and the power to seal demons disintegrated, scattering across various parts of the human world. While humans were embroiled in internal strife, more formidable demons began to emerge. The protagonist, the player, receives assistance from the priestess 'Seraphine' and embarks on a journey to collect seals to confront the demons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44762291/66d433e9df369774a426b0caac83684258273609.png[/img]
In this game, players explore their unique growth paths based on play patterns, with customization options for attributes to maximize the fun of item farming, a core element of enjoyment. Additionally, the game adopts a user-friendly quarter-view system rather than uniform full 3D graphics, and it features instant-form dungeons to enhance the enjoyment of item farming.

CHERRY CREDITS, responsible for global publishing, stated, "We believe that PC online games are the best platform for communication and cooperative play with other users." They added, "In this sense, 'SERAPH' is being prepared to capture the attention of users in the ARPG market, so we ask for your interest." Furthermore, the game is scheduled for release on mobile platforms in the future, with plans to provide multi-platform services.
